pr_body:
Add http and https proxy functions, and establish remote proxy server access by filling in the relevant http and https addresses.

for example： “http://192.168.1.3:12345” "https://192.168.1.3:443"

Also supports user authentication。

Fixes #7487 #5687

issue_context.title: HTTP proxy
issue_context.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/discussions/5687
Originally posted by **RafaelLinux** August 31, 2022 In my intranet, we require to use an http(s) proxy. RustDesk nowadays only works with socks proxy, so it shows "Connecting to the RustDesk network" forever and I don't get an ID. Please, could you add the HTTP(S) proxy feature? Thank you
comments: This will work on public free server and self-host `Pro`, since currently OSS self-host requires UDP, but http proxy does not support UDP.
Thanks, I will start this work

@rustdesk Hi, I have completed the core content of http proxy forwarding. Now I have a problem with the UI of the software.
![image](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/assets/33770335/7cde6f38-2c58-404d-a251-4a68b23d4e8d)
or
![image](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/assets/33770335/59e34332-f3d3-403d-a437-404334692b20)
，Which method should I take to complete the configuration of the http proxy?
Also, whether OSS self-hosting will change the protocol information in the future?

Please do on Flutter version, not the old Sciter version, yes you can do both also if sciter is easier for you to dev.
I have no plan to modify OSS self-host.
It adds http/https proxy, not replace current socks proxy. At any time, should only one proxy take effect. 
You can add a proxy-type option in current config and on current GUI.
